shared_elements: rectangular stone slab as the decorated field
horizontal band of repeated small units running across the upper part of the surface
warm buff/tan stone surface with weathered edges
justification: The only real correspondence is structural: both are tan rectangular stone panels whose upper zone carries a horizontal band of small repeated units above a larger figured or ornamental field below. Everything else diverges — A is shallow linear incision of script and a symmetrical foliate cross on a smoothed, mounted plaque, while B is low relief of animals in profile on a rough in-situ block, with no shared subject matter and no shared cutting technique.
